findings.body: If the local branch advances during merging and archiving then fails, the instructed `forge merge` retry always stops at this head check. It never reaches the MERGED path to archive outstanding conversations and preserve the advanced local branch. The suggested `forge close` cannot repair this: src/forge/close.py:57–60 returns through `_merged`, which only prints guidance at lines 247–258. Apply the local-head gate to unmerged pull requests; allow cleanup retries after verifying that the merged PR has the recorded head.
findings.title: Allow cleanup retries after the local branch advances
